Гуперзин А.about: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitor: better for Alzheimer's, but weak data; MCI has not been studied.
Гуперзин А.caution: Huperzine A is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor from the club moss plant (Chinese medicine). There are 3 Cochrane reviews: for Alzheimer's disease, vascular dementia and mild cognitive impairment. There is some effectiveness, but it is comparable to other AChE inhibitors (donepezil). Side effects: cholinergic (nausea, bradycardia). Caution: bradycardia, asthma, obstructive pulmonary disease.
Гуперзин А.food_sources: The club moss (Huperzia serrata) is not food; The supplement is a standardized plant extract.
Гуперзин А.guidelines: 2024 network MA (vascular dementia): effect; 2022 umbrella (BA): cognition is better in small RCTs. UKN: No RCT.
Гуперзин А.how_to_choose: H. serrata extract 50-200 mcg in cycles, not for asthma/bradycardia, not with cholinergic drugs.
mechs: Reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor (Huperzia serrata) → acetylcholine at synapses
Memory in dementia (used in China); healthy people have a weak, narrow window of safety
Neuroprotection: protection against beta-amyloid, glutamate, peroxide
BA: cognitive benefit from small RCTs, quality weak (Cochrane 2008)
Claimed use in vascular dementia and MCI
Vascular dementia: 1 RCT (14 people), MMSE WMD 2.40 ns; no RCT for UKN
Гуперзин А.myths: “Pumps up the brain of a healthy person” - RCT only for dementia. “It will save you from MCI” - no RCT. “Safe in any dose” - cholinergic side effects.
Гуперзин А.name: Huperzine A
Гуперзин А.onset: For course dementia (weeks or longer); does not provide acute “clarity” to a healthy person.
Гуперзин А.title: Huperzine A
Гуперзин А.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Гуперзин А.who_needs: Elderly with dementia - as prescribed by a doctor (used in China); healthy for the “brain” - no data; UKN without RCT.
